hypothesis: The causal near-ATM implied-vol level of the OTHER underlying (cross-asset atm_iv spillover) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward downside-semivariance share of the target underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-71 + alignment floor.
extends: EVAL-71/87/114 (atm_iv surface-bar signal verbatim + EVAL-71 surface floor) + EVAL-77 (cross-asset alignment via build_cross_section) + EVAL-115 (forward downside-semivariance-share target verbatim) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed); distinct cell: cross-asset atm_iv spillover -> forward downside semivariance share

protocol.title: Cross-asset near-ATM implied-vol spillover (other asset's atm_iv) -> forward own-asset downside-semivariance share predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-71/87/114 (atm_iv surface-bar signal verbatim + EVAL-71 surface floor) + EVAL-77 (cross-asset alignment via build_cross_section) + EVAL-115 (forward downside-semivariance-share target verbatim) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed); distinct cell: cross-asset atm_iv spillover -> forward downside semivariance share
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-115 (single-asset atm_iv), EVAL-114 (cross-asset atm_iv -> skewness), EVAL-144/145 (cross-asset term_ratio/term_slope -> downside); no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM implied-vol level of the OTHER underlying (e71.build_surface_bars atm_iv — SURFACE bar, not the term bar), aligned to the common BTC-vs-ETH bar grid (build_cross_section), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward downside-semivariance share = mean(min(r-mu,0)**2) / mean((r-mu)**2) over the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-115
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_atm_iv_z_k, own_dss_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher other-asset near-ATM IV -> more downside-concentrated forward variance on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

floor.note: Reuses the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor verbatim (min_option_trades_per_underlying=1000, min_near_atm_option_trades_per_underlying=400, min_perp_candles_per_underlying=1000, min_perp_span_seconds_per_underlying=82000s), applied to BOTH BTC and ETH, plus a cross-asset alignment floor (>= min_aligned_common_bars bar-ends where both underlyings carry a causal near-ATM atm_iv on the coarsest grid). Below the floor the campaign seals BLOCKED, never NO-GO. This is NOT the EVAL-64 ladder floor.
